theorem lg_target {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) : ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x := by
  have h_log_sqrt : Real.log √x = Real.log x / 2 := Real.log_sqrt (by linarith)
  let rhs := Real.log 4 * x / (Real.log x / 2) + √x
  let rhs_simplified := 2 * Real.log 4 * x / Real.log x + √x

  have h_floor_le_x : ⌊x⌋₊ ≤ x := by linarith
  have h_log_pos : 0 < Real.log x := Real.mul_log_pos hx
  have h_log_le_sub_one : Real.log x ≤ x - 1 := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by linarith)

  have h_bound : ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ / Real.log ⌊x⌋₊ :=
    by apply Nat.primeCounting_le_div_log

  calc
    ↑⌊x⌋₊.primeCounting ≤ ⌊x⌋₊ / Real.log ⌊x⌋₊ := h_bound
    ≤ x / Real.log ⌊x⌋₊ := h_floor_le_x
    ≤ x / (x - 1) := by {
      rw [h_log_le_sub_one],
      exact div_le_div_left (by linarith) (by linarith)
    }
    ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * x / Real.log x + √x := by {
      have h1 : x / (x - 1) ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * x / Real.log x :=
        by {
          have h2 : x - 1 ≤ Real.log x := h_log_le_sub_one.symm
          have h3 : 0 < Real.log x := h_log_pos
          have h4 : x / (x - 1) ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * x / Real.log x :=
            by {
              rw [div_eq_mul_inv, div_eq_mul_inv]
              exact mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) (by linarith)
            }
          exact h4
        }
      have h5 : x / (x - 1) ≤ 2 * Real.log 4 * x / Real.log x + √x :=
        by {
          exact add_le_add_right h1 √x
        }
      exact h5
    }
